constraints: Keep provider.runtime, Globals.Function.Runtime, per-function Runtime, and Terraform aws_lambda_function.runtime on one AWS Lambda runtime identifier that AWS still supports.
Raising the managed runtime can require .NET TFMs and package updates; confirm the project targets the replacement before deploying.

steps.instructions: Change the reported Runtime (or provider.runtime / terraform runtime) from dotnetcore3.1 to a supported AWS Lambda .NET identifier (see the replacement).
steps.title: Raise the AWS Lambda runtime

steps.instructions: Update every other SAM/CloudFormation Globals or function Runtime, serverless.yml provider or function runtime, Terraform aws_lambda_function.runtime, and CI deploy config that still pins dotnetcore3.1.
steps.title: Align other runtime surfaces

verification.command: sam validate || serverless print || terraform validate
verification.purpose: Validate the updated SAM, Serverless Framework, or Terraform declaration before deploy.

rule.summary: The AWS Lambda runtimes table lists dotnetcore3.1 under Deprecated runtimes with deprecation date 2023-04-03. AWS no longer applies security or other updates to that managed runtime.
rule.title: AWS Lambda .NET Core 3.1 runtime is end-of-life
